overview: The Geometric Halls are a labyrinth of shifting arcane geometry, the most unstable part of the Basilica.
history: Luclinite architects designed the halls as a geometric resonance buffer.
Arcane geometry was meant to stabilize void pulses from the core.
A resonance cascade destabilized the halls centuries ago.
Custodian constructs were assigned to maintain geometric alignment.
Akhevan intruders became trapped in recursive corridors.
hooks: A corridor folds into itself, trapping travelers.
Echo entities manifest in recursive loops.
Akhevan forces attempt to anchor the halls with ritual spikes.
